claims.section: Delivery methods must keep their own units
claims.claim: The Part of Children is taken **from Mars to Jupiter and projected from the Ascendant, both by day and by night**. In cyclic longitude notation the reference expression is `(Ascendant + Jupiter − Mars) mod 360°`. This is distinct from the retained Part of Fortune formula, `(Ascendant + Moon − Sun) mod 360°`. [XL, printed232 / PDF266, B028; retained XXIII, printed143–144 / PDF177–178, R625.]
